The '''''Personal Profit''''' was a modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that was owned by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Chalmer Trillili]]. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[The Scourge]], a small band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that were led by Trillili, and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Personal Profit'' participated in a Scourge attack on a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the [[Alluuvian system]].
